title: Throne of Miscellania
start: Talk to King Vargas in the castle of Miscellania, accessed from a longboat on the north coast of Rellekka.

items.t: Log of any kind (excluding Eternal magic logs) (may be harvested when needed)
Flowers (can be bought from the Flower Girl for 15 coins)
Cake (if the player is wooing Prince Brand)

Any bow (if the player is wooing Princess Astrid), excluding the training bow, composite bows, ogre bow, crystal bow, dark bow, chargebow, Kayle's chargebow, boogie bow, and masterwork bow; it will be lost during the quest

Any tradeable, metal ring (some rings, like the opal ring, lapis lazuli ring, jade ring, topaz ring, Ring of Wealth (4), moonstone ring, onyx ring, hydrix ring, and luck of the dwarves, do not work. The gold ring, sapphire ring, emerald ring, ruby ring, diamond ring, dragonstone ring, ring of life, are confirmed to work)

recommended.t: Weight-reducing clothing or a means to restore energy, due to the amount of running involved - Mint cakes are a cheap option, or the Endurance relic if you have 81 Archaeology.
A good hatchet or pickaxe, to assist in gathering resources to gain approval from the population.
Multiple Miscellania Teleports greatly reduces the walking times.

rewards.t: Ability to teleport to Miscellania with a Ring of Wealth, Ring of Fortune, or Luck of the Dwarves
Ability to purchase Miscellania Portrait from Sir Renitee.

steps.t: Talk to King Vargas, floor 2 in the castle on the western island of Miscellania. You'll first need to open the throne room door and click through the dialogue with the guard. [Chat: Accept]
Run to the eastern island. On the floor 2 of the castle, talk to Queen Sigrid.
Go back and talk to King Vargas.
Go back and talk to Queen Sigrid.
Talk to Prince Brand in the bedroom south of King Vargas's room. He will give you an awful anthem.
Talk to Advisor Ghrim in King Vargas's room. He adjusts the anthem, and the awful anthem will convert into a good anthem. [Chat: 2 How do I make peace with Etceteria?]
Take the good anthem to Queen Sigrid.
Talk to King Vargas.
Talk to Derrik at the anvil on the north of the island, and give him an iron bar. [Chat: 2 I have a slightly strange request...]
Use the giant nib on your logs.
Talk to King Vargas.
Talk to Advisor Ghrim about marriage. [Chat: 2 How am I supposed to get the Prince or Princess to marry me?]
Go to the room to the north and talk to Princess Astrid. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Princess Astrid again, read carefully what she says. You must agree with her.
Repeat this about 3 times until the chat options stop appearing.
Use the flowers on her. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Perform the Dance emote in her room.
Talk to Princess Astrid to tell her your name.
Talk to Princess Astrid again and agree with her again 3 times.

sub.t: That sounds like a good idea.
I'm quite fond of it myself.

steps.t: Give her a bow by using it on her. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Talk to Princess Astrid.
Talk to Princess Astrid again and agree with her again 3 times.

sub.t: I suppose you don't have much opportunity to.
And what a great bard he makes!

steps.t: Blow a kiss at Princess Astrid.
Use the ring on her. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Talk to King Vargas.
Go to the room to the south and talk to Prince Brand. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Prince Brand about 3 more times, trying to impress and/or agree with him.
Use the clap or cheer emote.
Use the flowers on him. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Talk to Prince Brand and agree with him again 3 times.
Listen to his saga.
Use the cake on him. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Talk to Prince Brand and agree with him again 3 times.
When he calls you 'Dear', blow a kiss at him.
Use the ring on Prince Brand. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Talk to King Vargas.
Talk to Advisor Ghrim about support. [Chat: 2 How do I gain the support of the population?]
You need to make the population like you. You can check your approval percentage by talking to the people you're helping. To do this, perform any of the following tasks on the island:

sub.t: Chopping trees (logs will not be obtained)
Mining coal (ore will not be obtained but it is the most AFK method here)
Fishing at the docks to the south (fish will not be obtained)
Purchase Flowers (mixed) from the Flower Girl (50% chance of +1% per flower)

p: Gaining support by chopping maple trees.

steps.t: Once you have 75% approval, talk to King Vargas.
Quest complete!
